segments.title: Cold Open & Pepito Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station cold-open from the control room, confirming the broadcast is live and identifying himself as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: Iran–Israel Ceasefire & JD Vance Intervention
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors the flagship news desk covering the fragile U.S.–Iran ceasefire, Israeli strikes on Lebanon, and a surprise live appearance by JD Vance that devolves into a piss-filter bit and a dominance contest over tongue-holding.

segments.title: Hype Train: Ceasefire Type Beat & CIA Sub Thank-You
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed for a freestyle session over 'ceasefire type beat' and 'CIA type beat,' thanking subs and bits donors including Skymer, Unfamous Amos, and Mighty Oz while riffing on bodily functions.

segments.title: Post-Train News Wrap & JD Vance Lingers
segments.notes: Case returns to the ceasefire analysis, debating whether the administration's diplomacy is flailing or a grand vision, while JD Vance refuses to leave the studio and eventually pees on toilet paper in the VP newspaper room.

segments.title: Movie Trailer Block: Michael, Lego One Piece, Hulk Hogan, Animal Farm
segments.notes: Case and chat watch trailers for the Michael Jackson biopic, a Lego One Piece event, a Netflix Hulk Hogan documentary, and an animated Animal Farm adaptation, debating nephew energy and kid-glove treatments.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Brief Newsroom Intrusion
segments.notes: Chet (and ChetAI) briefly interrupt to assert their news-boot qualifications and boot-pant hybrid wardrobe before being redirected to the news desk.

segments.title: Kendall In-Studio: Paramount Leads & Influencer Scandal
segments.notes: Kendall walks through the studio, discusses Paramount/Sony job leads, and breaks an influencer–teacher–student scandal involving multiple inappropriate relationships at the same school.

segments.title: Minesweeper High-Stakes Session with Kendall
segments.notes: Case and Kendall play an extended, sweat-drenched game of Minesweeper, narrating every logical deduction and near-death click while chat and suspense music amplify the tension.

segments.title: Wind-Down News: Brain Implants, Prostate Cancer, Deepfakes, AI Party Bot, Carol G
segments.notes: Rapid-fire closing headlines: quadriplegic musician uses brain implants for DJ sets, masturbation study links 21+ monthly sessions to lower prostate cancer risk, Ohio man convicted under federal deepfake law, car suspended on rock face as prank, AI bot organizes a Manchester party, and Carol G warned not to say 'ICE out' at Coachella.

segments.title: Raid Outro & Mat Tat Sub Goal Tease
segments.notes: Case raids Danny's channel, confirms the 'mat tat' sub goal merchandise is in transit, and signs off to get drinks with Crum.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the collapsing Iran–Israel ceasefire amid continued Israeli strikes on Lebanon, interrupted by a chaotic JD Vance appearance and a Hype Train freestyle derailment. The broadcast pivoted to a movie trailer block, a brief Chet Guy the Science Eyes intrusion, and an extended Minesweeper duel with Kendall before closing with rapid-fire headlines on brain-implant music, prostate cancer research, deepfake convictions, and Carol G's Coachella visa warning.
